finding.title: The debug statement that prints the body being sent could potentially expose sensitive information if the body contains user input or other sensitive data.
The debug statement that prints the body being sent could log sensitive information, which could be a security risk if the logs are accessible to unauthorized users.
The `memcpy` function is used without checking if the destination buffer (`ptr`) has enough space to hold the data being copied.
